Mat.28.18.bsb: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
Mat.28.18.kjv: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

Mat.18.10.bsb: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
Mat.18.10.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

Mat.2.13.bsb: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”
Mat.2.13.kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

Mat.2.20.bsb: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
Mat.2.20.kjv: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.

Mat.6.10.bsb: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Mat.6.10.kjv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

Mat.13.39.bsb: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
Mat.13.39.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

Mat.13.40.bsb: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
Mat.13.40.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

Mat.13.41.bsb: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
Mat.13.41.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

Mat.13.42.bsb: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Mat.13.42.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

Mat.28.2.bsb: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
Mat.28.2.kjv: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

Mat.1.20.bsb: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
Mat.1.20.kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

Mat.1.21.bsb: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
Mat.1.21.kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

Mat.28.5.bsb: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
Mat.28.5.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

Mat.28.6.bsb: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
Mat.28.6.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

Mat.28.7.bsb: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
Mat.28.7.kjv: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

Mat.4.11.bsb: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.
Mat.4.11.kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

Mat.24.31.bsb: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
Mat.24.31.kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

Mat.16.27.bsb: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
Mat.16.27.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

Mat.25.31.bsb: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.
Mat.25.31.kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

Mat.26.53.bsb: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
Mat.26.53.kjv: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

Mat.21.42.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
Mat.21.42.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

Mat.10.1.bsb: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
Mat.10.1.kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

Mat.10.7.bsb: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’
Mat.10.7.kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

Mat.28.19.bsb: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
Mat.28.19.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

Mat.11.27.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
Mat.11.27.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

Mat.4.23.bsb: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
Mat.4.23.kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

Mat.11.5.bsb: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
Mat.11.5.kjv: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

Mat.24.3.bsb: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
Mat.24.3.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

Mat.24.4.bsb: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.
Mat.24.4.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

Mat.24.5.bsb: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
Mat.24.5.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

Mat.24.6.bsb: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
Mat.24.6.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

Mat.24.7.bsb: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
Mat.24.7.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

Mat.24.8.bsb: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
Mat.24.8.kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

Mat.24.9.bsb: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
Mat.24.9.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.

Mat.24.10.bsb: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
Mat.24.10.kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

Mat.24.11.bsb: and many false prophets will arise and deceive many.
Mat.24.11.kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

Mat.24.12.bsb: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
Mat.24.12.kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

Mat.24.13.bsb: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
Mat.24.13.kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

Mat.24.14.bsb: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
Mat.24.14.kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

Mat.24.15.bsb: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ spoken of by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
Mat.24.15.kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

Mat.24.16.bsb: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
Mat.24.16.kjv: Then let them which be in Judea flee into the mountains:

Mat.24.17.bsb: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
Mat.24.17.kjv: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

Mat.24.18.bsb: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
Mat.24.18.kjv: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

Mat.24.19.bsb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
Mat.24.19.kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

Mat.24.20.bsb: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
Mat.24.20.kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

Mat.24.21.bsb: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unseen from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
Mat.24.21.kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

Mat.24.22.bsb: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
Mat.24.22.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.

Mat.24.23.bsb: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
Mat.24.23.kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

Mat.24.24.bsb: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
Mat.24.24.kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

Mat.24.25.bsb: See, I have told you in advance.
Mat.24.25.kjv: Behold, I have told you before.

Mat.24.26.bsb: So if they tell you, ‘There He is, in the wilderness,’ do not go out, or, ‘Here He is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
Mat.24.26.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

Mat.24.27.bsb: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
Mat.24.27.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

Mat.24.28.bsb: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
Mat.24.28.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

Mat.24.29.bsb: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
Mat.24.29.kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

Mat.24.30.bsb: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
Mat.24.30.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

Mat.24.32.bsb: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
Mat.24.32.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

Mat.24.33.bsb: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
Mat.24.33.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

Mat.24.34.bsb: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
Mat.24.34.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

Mat.24.35.bsb: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
Mat.24.35.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

Mat.13.54.bsb: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.
Mat.13.54.kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

Mat.12.17.bsb: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
Mat.12.17.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

Mat.12.18.bsb: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.
Mat.12.18.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

Mat.12.19.bsb: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.
Mat.12.19.kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

Mat.12.20.bsb: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.
Mat.12.20.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

Mat.17.25.bsb: “Yes,” he answered. When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. “What do you think, Simon?” He asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?”
Mat.17.25.kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

Mat.17.5.bsb: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
Mat.17.5.kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

Mat.12.25.bsb: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
Mat.12.25.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

Mat.3.17.bsb: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
Mat.3.17.kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

Mat.25.33.bsb: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.
Mat.25.33.kjv: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

Mat.17.2.bsb: There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
Mat.17.2.kjv: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

Mat.15.19.bsb: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
Mat.15.19.kjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

Mat.4.8.bsb: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
Mat.4.8.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

Mat.6.2.bsb: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
Mat.6.2.kjv: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

Mat.10.30.bsb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
Mat.10.30.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

Mat.5.36.bsb: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
Mat.5.36.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

Mat.27.33.bsb: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
Mat.27.33.kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

Mat.6.17.bsb: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
Mat.6.17.kjv: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

Mat.27.39.bsb: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads
Mat.27.39.kjv: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

Mat.14.10.bsb: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
Mat.14.10.kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

Mat.1.18.bsb: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
Mat.1.18.kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

Mat.1.16.bsb: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
Mat.1.16.kjv: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

Mat.1.25.bsb: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
Mat.1.25.kjv: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

Mat.2.2.bsb: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
Mat.2.2.kjv: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

Mat.26.38.bsb: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.”
Mat.26.38.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

Mat.4.2.bsb: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.
Mat.4.2.kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

Mat.21.18.bsb: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He was hungry.
Mat.21.18.kjv: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

Mat.8.24.bsb: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves. But Jesus was sleeping.
Mat.8.24.kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

Mat.26.67.bsb: Then they spit in His face and struck Him. Others slapped Him
Mat.26.67.kjv: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

Mat.27.26.bsb: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
Mat.27.26.kjv: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.

Mat.27.59.bsb: So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
Mat.27.59.kjv: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

Mat.27.60.bsb: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.
Mat.27.60.kjv: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

Mat.22.42.bsb: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?” “David’s,” they answered.
Mat.22.42.kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

Mat.1.1.bsb: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
Mat.1.1.kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

Mat.1.2.bsb: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.
Mat.1.2.kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

Mat.1.3.bsb: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.
Mat.1.3.kjv: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

Mat.1.4.bsb: Ram was the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon.
Mat.1.4.kjv: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

Mat.1.5.bsb: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
Mat.1.5.kjv: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

Mat.1.6.bsb: and Jesse the father of David the king. Next: David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,
Mat.1.6.kjv: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

Mat.1.7.bsb: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa.
Mat.1.7.kjv: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

Mat.1.8.bsb: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah.
Mat.1.8.kjv: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

Mat.1.9.bsb: Uzziah was the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.
Mat.1.9.kjv: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

Mat.1.10.bsb: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,
Mat.1.10.kjv: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

Mat.1.11.bsb: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
Mat.1.11.kjv: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

Mat.1.12.bsb: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
Mat.1.12.kjv: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

Mat.1.13.bsb: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.
Mat.1.13.kjv: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

Mat.1.14.bsb: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.
Mat.1.14.kjv: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

Mat.1.15.bsb: Eliud was the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
Mat.1.15.kjv: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

Mat.1.17.bsb: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.

Mat.8.20.bsb: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
Mat.8.20.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

Mat.16.13.bsb: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”
Mat.16.13.kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

Mat.19.5.bsb: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?

Mat.19.3.bsb: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
Mat.19.3.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

Mat.19.4.bsb: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’

Mat.19.6.bsb: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
Mat.19.6.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

Mat.19.7.bsb: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”
Mat.19.7.kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

Mat.19.8.bsb: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart. But it was not this way from the beginning.
Mat.19.8.kjv: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

Mat.19.9.bsb: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.”
Mat.19.9.kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

Mat.19.29.bsb: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
Mat.19.29.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

Mat.8.4.bsb: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”
Mat.8.4.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

Mat.8.3.bsb: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

Mat.10.8.bsb: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
Mat.10.8.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

Mat.22.37.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

Mat.22.38.bsb: This is the first and greatest commandment.
Mat.22.38.kjv: This is the first and great commandment.

Mat.22.39.bsb: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
Mat.22.39.kjv: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

Mat.5.44.bsb: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

Mat.25.35.bsb: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
Mat.25.35.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

Mat.25.36.bsb: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
Mat.25.36.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

Mat.18.15.bsb: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
Mat.18.15.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

Mat.6.25.bsb: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
Mat.6.25.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

Mat.6.26.bsb: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
Mat.6.26.kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

Mat.10.31.kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

Mat.12.12.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

Mat.7.6.kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

Mat.7.7.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

Mat.4.10.bsb: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus told him. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”

Mat.6.11.kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.

Mat.6.33.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

Mat.6.13.bsb: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’
Mat.6.13.kjv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

Mat.6.7.kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

Mat.6.5.bsb: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
Mat.6.5.kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

Mat.26.39.bsb: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”
Mat.26.39.kjv: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

Mat.21.11.bsb: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
Mat.21.11.kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

Mat.23.14.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

Mat.15.22.kjv: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

Mat.14.23.bsb: After He had dismissed them, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,
Mat.14.23.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

Mat.26.36.bsb: Then Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
Mat.26.36.kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

Mat.6.6.bsb: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
Mat.6.6.kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

Mat.18.20.bsb: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”

Mat.18.19.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

Mat.1.22.bsb: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
Mat.1.22.kjv: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

Mat.1.23.bsb: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).
Mat.1.23.kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

Mat.2.1.bsb: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,
Mat.2.1.kjv: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

Mat.2.3.bsb: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
Mat.2.3.kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

Mat.2.4.bsb: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
Mat.2.4.kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

Mat.2.5.bsb: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:
Mat.2.5.kjv: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

Mat.2.6.bsb: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’”
Mat.2.6.kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

Mat.2.7.bsb: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.
Mat.2.7.kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

Mat.2.8.bsb: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”
Mat.2.8.kjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

Mat.2.9.kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

Mat.2.10.bsb: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.
Mat.2.10.kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

Mat.2.11.bsb: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
Mat.2.11.kjv: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

Mat.2.16.bsb: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
Mat.2.16.kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

Mat.2.17.bsb: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:
Mat.2.17.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,

Mat.2.18.bsb: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
Mat.2.18.kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

Mat.2.15.bsb: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
Mat.2.15.kjv: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

Mat.3.1.kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judea,

Mat.3.3.kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

Mat.3.16.bsb: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
Mat.3.16.kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

Mat.4.12.kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

Mat.4.16.kjv: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

Mat.21.2.kjv: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.

Mat.21.3.bsb: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
Mat.21.3.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

Mat.21.4.bsb: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
Mat.21.4.kjv: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

Mat.21.5.bsb: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’”
Mat.21.5.kjv: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

Mat.12.16.bsb: warning them not to make Him known.

Mat.13.35.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

Mat.27.58.kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

Mat.23.34.bsb: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from town to town.
Mat.23.34.kjv: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

Mat.7.22.bsb: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
Mat.7.22.kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

Mat.3.4.bsb: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
Mat.3.4.kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

Mat.12.39.bsb: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
Mat.12.39.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

Mat.5.12.bsb: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
Mat.5.12.kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

Mat.23.35.bsb: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
Mat.23.35.kjv: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

Mat.23.36.bsb: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
Mat.23.36.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

Mat.23.37.bsb: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
Mat.23.37.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

Mat.23.38.bsb: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
Mat.23.38.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

Mat.24.1.bsb: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
Mat.24.1.kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

Mat.24.2.bsb: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
Mat.24.2.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

Mat.24.36.bsb: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
Mat.24.36.kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

Mat.24.37.bsb: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
Mat.24.37.kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

Mat.24.38.bsb: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
Mat.24.38.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

Mat.24.39.bsb: And they were oblivious until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
Mat.24.39.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

Mat.24.40.bsb: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
Mat.24.40.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

Mat.24.41.bsb: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
Mat.24.41.kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

Mat.24.42.bsb: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.
Mat.24.42.kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

Mat.24.43.bsb: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
Mat.24.43.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

Mat.24.44.bsb: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
Mat.24.44.kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

Mat.24.45.bsb: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
Mat.24.45.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

Mat.24.46.bsb: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
Mat.24.46.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

Mat.24.47.bsb: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
Mat.24.47.kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

Mat.24.48.bsb: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
Mat.24.48.kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

Mat.24.49.bsb: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
Mat.24.49.kjv: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

Mat.24.50.bsb: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
Mat.24.50.kjv: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

Mat.24.51.bsb: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Mat.24.51.kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

Mat.25.1.bsb: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
Mat.25.1.kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

Mat.25.2.bsb: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
Mat.25.2.kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

Mat.25.3.bsb: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take along any extra oil.
Mat.25.3.kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

Mat.25.4.bsb: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps.
Mat.25.4.kjv: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

Mat.25.5.bsb: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
Mat.25.5.kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

Mat.25.6.bsb: At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
Mat.25.6.kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

Mat.25.7.bsb: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
Mat.25.7.kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

Mat.25.8.bsb: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
Mat.25.8.kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

Mat.25.9.bsb: ‘No,’ said the wise ones, ‘or there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
Mat.25.9.kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

Mat.25.10.bsb: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
Mat.25.10.kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

Mat.25.11.bsb: Later the other virgins arrived and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us!’
Mat.25.11.kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

Mat.25.12.bsb: But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
Mat.25.12.kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

Mat.25.13.bsb: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
Mat.25.13.kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

Mat.25.14.bsb: For it is just like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted them with his possessions.
Mat.25.14.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

Mat.25.15.bsb: To one he gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent—each according to his own ability. And he went on his journey.
Mat.25.15.kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

Mat.25.16.bsb: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and gained five more.
Mat.25.16.kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

Mat.25.17.bsb: Likewise, the one with the two talents gained two more.
Mat.25.17.kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

Mat.25.18.bsb: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
Mat.25.18.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

Mat.25.19.bsb: After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
Mat.25.19.kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

Mat.25.20.bsb: The servant who had received the five talents came and presented five more. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more.’
Mat.25.20.kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

Mat.25.21.bsb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
Mat.25.21.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

Mat.25.22.bsb: The servant who had received the two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you entrusted me with two talents. See, I have gained two more.’
Mat.25.22.kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

Mat.25.23.bsb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
Mat.25.23.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

Mat.25.24.bsb: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
Mat.25.24.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

Mat.25.25.bsb: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what belongs to you.’
Mat.25.25.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

Mat.25.26.bsb: ‘You wicked, lazy servant!’ replied his master. ‘You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed.
Mat.25.26.kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

Mat.25.27.bsb: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it back with interest.
Mat.25.27.kjv: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

Mat.25.28.bsb: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
Mat.25.28.kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

Mat.25.29.bsb: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. But the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
Mat.25.29.kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

Mat.25.30.bsb: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
Mat.25.30.kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

Mat.25.32.bsb: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
Mat.25.32.kjv: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

Mat.25.34.bsb: Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
Mat.25.34.kjv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

Mat.25.37.bsb: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?
Mat.25.37.kjv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

Mat.25.38.bsb: When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or naked and clothe You?
Mat.25.38.kjv: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

Mat.25.39.bsb: When did we see You sick or in prison and visit You?’
Mat.25.39.kjv: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

Mat.25.40.bsb: And the King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.’
Mat.25.40.kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

Mat.25.41.bsb: Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
Mat.25.41.kjv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

Mat.25.42.bsb: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink,
Mat.25.42.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

Mat.25.43.bsb: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, I was naked and you did not clothe Me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after Me.’
Mat.25.43.kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

Mat.25.44.bsb: And they too will reply, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to You?’
Mat.25.44.kjv: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

Mat.25.45.bsb: Then the King will answer, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me.’
Mat.25.45.kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

Mat.25.46.bsb: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
Mat.25.46.kjv: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

Mat.7.15.bsb: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
Mat.7.15.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

Mat.15.2.bsb: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”
Mat.15.2.kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

Mat.5.9.bsb: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
Mat.5.9.kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

Mat.5.45.bsb: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
Mat.5.45.kjv: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

Mat.13.43.bsb: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.
Mat.13.43.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

Mat.1.24.bsb: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him and embraced Mary as his wife.
Mat.1.24.kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

Mat.2.19.bsb: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
Mat.2.19.kjv: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

Mat.22.30.bsb: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
Mat.22.30.kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

Mat.28.3.bsb: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
Mat.28.3.kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

Mat.28.4.bsb: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
Mat.28.4.kjv: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

Mat.13.49.bsb: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous
Mat.13.49.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

Mat.4.6.bsb: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
Mat.4.6.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

Mat.13.50.bsb: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Mat.13.50.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

Mat.17.3.bsb: Suddenly Moses and Elijah appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
Mat.17.3.kjv: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

Mat.5.22.bsb: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
Mat.5.22.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

Mat.22.7.bsb: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.
Mat.22.7.kjv: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

Mat.22.13.bsb: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
Mat.22.13.kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

Mat.5.13.bsb: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
Mat.5.13.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

Mat.12.45.bsb: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”
Mat.12.45.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

Mat.26.69.bsb: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him. “You also were with Jesus the Galilean,” she said.
Mat.26.69.kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

Mat.26.70.bsb: But he denied it before them all: “I do not know what you are talking about.”
Mat.26.70.kjv: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

Mat.26.71.bsb: When Peter had gone out to the gateway, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
Mat.26.71.kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

Mat.26.72.bsb: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man!”
Mat.26.72.kjv: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

Mat.26.73.bsb: After a little while, those standing nearby came up to Peter. “Surely you are one of them,” they said, “for your accent gives you away.”
Mat.26.73.kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

Mat.26.74.bsb: At that he began to curse and swear to them, “I do not know the man!” And immediately a rooster crowed.
Mat.26.74.kjv: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

Mat.26.75.bsb: Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
Mat.26.75.kjv: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

Mat.5.42.bsb: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
Mat.5.42.kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

Mat.19.21.bsb: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
Mat.19.21.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

Mat.10.25.bsb: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
Mat.10.25.kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

Mat.12.31.bsb: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
Mat.12.31.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

Mat.12.32.bsb: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.
Mat.12.32.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

Mat.27.63.bsb: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
Mat.27.63.kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

Mat.26.65.bsb: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
Mat.26.65.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

Mat.9.27.bsb: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”
Mat.9.27.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.

Mat.9.28.bsb: After Jesus had entered the house, the blind men came to Him. “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” He asked. “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
Mat.9.28.kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

Mat.9.29.bsb: Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.”
Mat.9.29.kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

Mat.9.30.bsb: And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!”
Mat.9.30.kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

Mat.12.22.bsb: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
Mat.12.22.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

Mat.21.14.bsb: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.
Mat.21.14.kjv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

Mat.20.30.bsb: And there were two blind men sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
Mat.20.30.kjv: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

Mat.20.31.bsb: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
Mat.20.31.kjv: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

Mat.20.32.bsb: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want Me to do for you?” He asked.
Mat.20.32.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

Mat.20.33.bsb: “Lord,” they answered, “let our eyes be opened.”
Mat.20.33.kjv: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

Mat.20.34.bsb: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and at once they received their sight and followed Him.
Mat.20.34.kjv: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

Mat.5.15.bsb: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
Mat.5.15.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

Mat.5.16.bsb: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
Mat.5.16.kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

Mat.6.23.bsb: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
Mat.6.23.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

Mat.13.13.bsb: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
Mat.13.13.kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

Mat.13.14.bsb: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
Mat.13.14.kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

Mat.13.15.bsb: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
Mat.13.15.kjv: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

Mat.13.16.bsb: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
Mat.13.16.kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

Mat.13.19.bsb: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
Mat.13.19.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

Mat.15.14.bsb: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
Mat.15.14.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

Mat.16.3.bsb: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
Mat.16.3.kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

Mat.22.29.bsb: Jesus answered, “You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
Mat.22.29.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

Mat.23.16.bsb: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
Mat.23.16.kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

Mat.23.17.bsb: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
Mat.23.17.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

Mat.23.18.bsb: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
Mat.23.18.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

Mat.23.19.bsb: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes it sacred?
Mat.23.19.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

Mat.23.20.bsb: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
Mat.23.20.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

Mat.23.21.bsb: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
Mat.23.21.kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

Mat.23.22.bsb: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
Mat.23.22.kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

Mat.23.23.bsb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
Mat.23.23.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

Mat.23.24.bsb: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
Mat.23.24.kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

Mat.23.26.bsb: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
Mat.23.26.kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

Mat.9.3.bsb: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
Mat.9.3.kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

Mat.9.15.bsb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
Mat.9.15.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

Mat.18.25.bsb: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.
Mat.18.25.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

Mat.9.18.bsb: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”
